builds.name: Leveling — Arms two-hander (Mortal Strike at 40, Enrage last)
builds.summary: Two-handed Arms leveling revised from the fight lab on 2026-09-26: Improved Rend, Deflection, Improved Charge and Improved Overpower first, Deep Wounds at 20, Impale and Two-Handed Weapon Specialization, Bloodthrill, Weaponmaster and Mortal Strike at 40 (the one talent worth 40% of time per kill), then Fury for Cruelty, Unbridled Wrath, Blood Craze and Enrage. Overpower crits: +5-6%.
+3% crit with an axe or polearm: +5%.
+2 rage per white hit with a two-hander: +4%.
+5% parry: +3% per kill and fewer deaths; also the cheapest way to 30 Arms points.
